programme.desc: Kom beleef Afrikaans is 100 Jaar Groot vanuit die gemak van jou rusbank.

programme.title: Tydlose Skoonheid
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Gewone mense deel die inspirerende stories van hoe 'n gesonde leefstyl asook Zinplex-produkte hulle gehelp het om ouerword met meer elegansie en moed aan te pak.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks

programme.title: Afrikaans Is 100 Jaar Groot

programme.title: Herman En Die Ladies
programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. Ingrid was 40 toe borskanker by haar gediagnoseer is en haar 3 kinders nog baie jonk was. Ewe skielik het die werklikheid van borskanker haar in die gesig gestaar.

programme.title: Die Beste In Die Weste
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Betree die wêreld van potterbakkerkuns waar klei lewe in Clementina van der Walt se hande kry. In haar Woodstock-ateljee lei haar soeke na die heilige in die alledaagse haar tot skeppings wat nuwe betekenis kry.

programme.title: Gesels
programme.desc: 'S6/E8'. 'n Uithourugby- en adrenaliensport-entoesias breek in April 2024 sy rug en pelvis. Nou het Carel Botha se lewe 'n nuwe doel. Marltons Pet Care deel hoe om 'n kat met katstrooi te bederf.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Allesverloren: Vyf generasies van die Malan-familie sorg al vir jare dat onvergeetlike wyn by Riebeeck-Kasteel gemaak word. Aan die stuur tans is 'n boetie-en-sussie-span wat dié wynplaas verder vat in die 21ste eeu.

programme.title: Hier Sit Die Manne
programme.desc: 'S10/E7'. Kingsley Holgate kuier by Frank en gesels oor sy ekspedisies en humanitêre missies. Ons leer meer oor persoonlikheidsversteurings, en kies die regte verf vir jou kombuis.

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S2/E2'. Die Commitee en Choristers is almal lede van die Stellenbosse Universiteitskoor wie se musiekkennis behoorlik getoets word. Wie gaan die rande laat inrol?

programme.title: Kom Ons Braai
programme.desc: 'S10/E12'. Ons gunstelingtydverdryf is nou 'n sosiale eksperiment. Drie paartjies wat mekaar nie ken nie, braai by mekaar en heelwat gebeur om die vuur. En ons praat nie net van die lekker kos nie!

programme.title: Wie weet wat?
programme.desc: 'S1/E27'. Abri, Brandon en Bossie sal 'n goeie strategie wil inspan met die vrae wanneer hulle in hierdie episode teen mekaar te staan kom. Hul algemene kennis alleen gaan nie genoeg wees nie.

programme.title: Herman En Die Ladies
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Karen was 38 toe borskanker by haar gediagnoseer is nadat sy vir 'n borsreduksie gegaan het. En teen alle verwagtinge in raak sy swanger met haar laatlam! Herman bederf haar met 'n feesmaal.

programme.title: Die Beste In Die Weste
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. By Muratie buite Stellenbosch, soos wat die spinnerakke simboliseer, loop die hede en verlede hand aan hand. Ontdek dié karaktervolle wynlandgoed wat sy erfenis omarm en dié vereer wat 'n groot rol in sy bestaan gespeel het.

programme.title: Gesels
programme.desc: 'S6/E9'. Waar ander haar klompvoete as beperking sien, was dit vir Tinka Fox 'n geleentheid om te oortref. Irusha wys hoe om Kersfees-opruim lekker te maak, en ons eet beesskenkelpastei met rys danksy Herman en die nuutste SARIE kos.

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E4'. Boompie Alleen: Hierdie week is ons in Vrede in die Vrystaat en ontmoet die Fourie-familie, wat al vir vyf generasies met beeste en sojabone boer.

programme.title: Hier Sit Die Manne
programme.desc: 'S10/E8'. Van grafiese ontwerper na die wêreld se sterkste vrou - Brendali Theron deel haar inspirerende reis. Ons breek die stigma oor depressie, leer van verfvoorbereiding, en kry 4x4-wenke saam met Isuzu.

programme.title: Slim Vang Sy Baas: Musiek
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Die Suikerbessies en Schayes takel mekaar in agt rondes van musiekvasvrae en ander nuwe speletjies. Wie staan die kans om as die wenners van die episode gekroon te word?

programme.title: Dr. Nou

programme.desc: 'S2/E5'. The Cape Route Rally hits Europe with Nürburgring and Spa thrills, Porsche and Mercedes heritage, and a finale at Zandvoort's F1 track, an epic blend of speed, history and culture.

programme.title: Best Of IGNITION
programme.desc: 'S4/E1'. Join us as we take a trip down memory lane as we look back at Ignition best moments of 2025.

programme.title: Kasi Car Culture
programme.desc: 'S10/E1'. Season 10 of KCC kicks off in Westonaria at the 'Weet Jou Ma Jy Spin' show, with car quizzes, fan features, and a surprise luxury ride! Hosted by SbudaPaloni and Cool Car Chick.

programme.title: SA Car Culture with Cars.co.za
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. DJ Chrizz Beatz reminisces about saving for his first car, Lala shares her first-car love story, and Primo drops a quirky tale from his matric dance days.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S25/E51'. Ernest drives the sensational MG Cyberster. We visit the home of BYD in China, join an economy challenge with Omoda & Jaecoo, while Zee puts the Haval H7 through its paces.

programme.title: Giving it Gears with Jason Goliath
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Jason teams up with hard enduro athlete Kirsten Landman for a dune showdown in Atlantis. Buggies, bikes, and sand make for an epic off-road battle.

programme.title: The IGNITION Giveaway Show
programme.desc: 'S4/E1'. Tis the season to be festive! It's the time for giving, sharing and that means it's time for Ignition TV's annual Motoring Gifts Giveaway show. We have plenty of motoring goodies.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 'S5/E6'. Porsche's 911 GTS closed the gap between the S and the GT3 in their sports car model range. The Roding Roadster, a handcrafted lightweight sports car with technology by BMW.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: 'S5/E7'. The Porsche Macan Turbo, Mercedes GLA 45 AMG, and Audi RSQ3 are sporty SUVs with year-round capability and performance rivaling that of true sports cars.

programme.title: Auto Mundial
programme.desc: 'S25/E51'. Skoda celebrates 130 years with three new models, joined by an Italian-flair midsize SUV. We also revisit a refreshed Testarossa and ask whether Ferrari improved with the F40.

programme.title: Rev
programme.desc: 'S25/E51'. Classic cars dominate Malta's roads, mainly British, with some old Indian vehicles still running. A German logistics firm also trains African drivers for trucking jobs.

programme.title: IGNITION Goes To SEMA
programme.desc: 'S3/E4'. Anatalia Villaranda debuts a karaoke-ready custom ride, a father-son duo rolls out a '60s C10, Randy Branum shows his build, and a 1972 Super Beetle shines.

programme.title: 4WD To The Max
programme.desc: 'S5/E4'. It's the final showdown to decide who heads to the final, and who goes home. Can the trainee and aerobatic pilots reel in the all-conquering jet jocks? And who will be voted out.

programme.title: Tuned In SA
programme.desc: 'S4/E8'. Vic and Trinisha throw us back to Season 4 to catch up on some cool tuned cars and best modifications from South Africa.

programme.title: Razor Customs
programme.desc: 'S3/E8 of 13'. Razor Customs gives you an inside look into the world of our local tuners.

programme.title: ALL THINGS MOTORING
programme.desc: 'S11/E16'. This week on All Things Motoring! Mike dives into the world of Jaguars & Ernest returns to the Killarney Motor show. This is a show that drives passion & pure motoring magic.

programme.title: The Bike Show
programme.desc: 'S25/E51'. On The Bike Show this week, some crazy people ride up the side of mountains in Lesotho for the Roof of Africa Hard Enduro.

programme.title: Motor Mythbusters
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Detonation Deflection/EV Range'. The team investigates a movie myth about a car bomb. They also test an EV's battery life, range, and charging under different conditions.
